verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MU nsi y'omu ggulu
Tewabaawo kiro,
Emirimu tegikoya
Bakoza-okwagala.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Eri teri nnaku,
Essanyu lingi nnyo:
Katonda waffe-asangula
Amaziga gonna.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Eri teri kibi:
Abaliyo bonna
Bambadde-engoye-entukuvu,
Bayimbira Yesu.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Eri teri kufa:
Abaayingira-eyo,
Baamala bo okusikira
Obulamu-obutaggwaawo.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Yesu,musaale ggwe,
Otukulembere;
-Otuyise mu kabi konna
Otutuuse mu ggulu
